identity.name: Superocean Heritage '57
identity.one_liner: Breitling's April 2020 capsule revival of the 1957 SuperOcean, offered in 42mm steel with a concave ceramic bezel.

provenance_events.description: Breitling launches the Superocean Heritage '57 as a fashion-industry-style "capsule collection" — limited-time rather than limited-number — reviving the case proportions of the 1957 SuperOcean, including a 250-piece rainbow-marker colorway within the release.

narrative.story: The Superocean Heritage '57 revives the case proportions of Breitling's original 1957 SuperOcean dive watch. Breitling framed the April 2020 relaunch explicitly as a "capsule collection" — a limited-time release rather than a numbered limited edition — pairing 1950s dial and bezel styling with the automatic Caliber 10 movement.
narrative.collector_notes: The 2020 capsule included a 250-piece rainbow-hour-marker colorway on a distinct reference suffix; confirm the exact reference and bracelet (leather vs. mesh), since pricing and availability differ meaningfully between configurations within the family.
